Services.title: Website and app development — one process to launch
Services.lead: I turn a brief, a mock, or a messy idea into a working digital product — from landing pages to fullstack services.

items.title: Websites and landing pages
items.text: A page built for a specific job: clear offer, responsive layout, forms, analytics.

items.title: Web apps and services
items.text: Products with real user flows: accounts, roles, data, payments, integrations.

items.title: AI inside the product
items.text: Chat, RAG, gateway, streaming — wired into the scenario, not bolted on as a widget.

items.title: Backend and APIs
items.text: Auth, databases, provider proxies, Docker, deploy — so the UI has something solid behind it.

items.title: MVP to test the idea
items.text: A first version you can show customers, collect feedback, and decide what to build next.

items.title: Work on existing code
items.text: I’ll read the legacy, fix the bottleneck, wire CI, and push it to release.

Stack.title: Fullstack with a shipping bias
Stack.lead: I can join a team, own a feature end to end, or take a product from brief to production.
